source_en: Back from the apiary. Cleaned frames. Going to my room.
Shift at the building site is done. Home to the crew flat.
Picking up more smoke canisters.
From the apiary. The site closed. Only the bees now.
Checking the sugar water supplies.
Seeking a medical check for my head.
Went to the hives to say goodbye. Going home.
Returning to my assigned residence.
Looking for the master. He was not at the hives.
Allergic to bee stings. Seeing a doctor about it.
Collecting my pension from the apiary cooperative.
Coaching the junior debate team. Fast talkers win.
Day shift at the building site. Busy as ever.
Moving to the city from Zugdidi. First week here.
Selling the master's hives. I was never fond of bees.
Taking over the apiary. I am the master now.
Retiring at forty-five. Moving to the coast.
Lost my way. I have never been to the east side.
Hello. I... have my papers. Somewhere.
The bees are... very quiet today. It is nice.
I am returning. The master says I am finished.
The hives are melting. But... there is no heat.
My head feels... heavy. Like it is full of honey.
The air tastes like... burnt sugar and metal.
I can hear the queen. She is... under my skin.
There is no more Emzar. Only... the swarm.
The sky is a dead eye. I am blinking.
Thank you. I... will go now. Slowly.
The buzzing... it is getting louder inside. Goodbye.
We will all... be... together soon.
A small room? That is... fine. I like boxes.
The walls are white. Like... a fresh comb.
The hive is growing here. I can feel it.
Oh. That... was quite... loud.
Everything is... turning... gold.
Finally... the swarm... is free.
White walls. The bees prefer... white. This is... acceptable.
I will wait here. I am very good... at waiting.
The buzzing in my head is... quieter in here. That is... nice.
Oh. The buzzing... it is very loud... and then... it stops.
The queen... she is calling me... home...
Everything is turning... very still... That is... okay.
Where are you coming from?
The apiary. East side. I cleaned frames. The bees were... quiet. Good day.
The apiary. The hives are... wrong. The site closed. So... only the bees now.
The hives. I went to... say goodbye. The master was not there.
The honey cooperative. West district. I am... the master there. I run the hives.
The apiary. Master Tengiz sent me home early. He said... rest.
Home. My mother's flat. I have always... lived with her. It is quiet.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
My chest is... tight. Dust from the site. The foreman says so.
My head is heavy. Like it is full of... honey. And I cough. Something dark.
I do not sleep. When I do... I wake up wet. My ears ring.
No. My chest is... clear. I do not work at any site. Only the bees.
My head is... light. Very clear. I have not needed... any doctor.
Nothing. I am... forty now. The body... settles at forty.
The bees are... very restless today. More than usual.
You smell... not like smoke. That is... unusual. In a good way.
I counted the steps from the apiary to here. It is always the same number. Mostly.
There is a buzzing in this booth. Can you hear it? It is... lower than bees.
The air tastes different today. Like... burnt sugar. You do not taste it?
My head is... heavier lately. I think it is filling with something.
The queen is very close now. I can feel her. Through the walls.
You do not need to worry about me. I am... being taken care of.
The swarm is coming. Not here. Somewhere better.
